# FG-REVIEW-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_full_discussion_or_merge_request_refuses_more` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストのスレッドかコメントが上限に達しました。既存のスレッドで続けるか、新しいマージリクエストに分けてください。
- en: This merge request has reached its limit of discussions or comments. Continue in an existing discussion, or split the work into a new merge request.
- id: Merge request ini telah mencapai batas diskusi atau komentar. Lanjutkan di diskusi yang ada, atau pisahkan pekerjaan ke merge request baru.

## 原因 (cause)

A discussion was to be started or a note added (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/discussions`, `…/discussions/{discussion_id}/notes`) while the merge request already holds the most the server keeps (M3 R3 review): reason=discussions_per_merge_request (500 discussions), notes_per_merge_request (5 000 notes) or notes_per_discussion (200 notes in one discussion). The counts are taken under the merge request's row lock, so concurrent writers cannot pass the cap. The caps equal the list's caps, so a list never leaves anything out. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `limit`, `project_id`, `iid` and `merge_request_id` (and `discussion_id` for notes_per_discussion). Count read-only: SELECT count(*) FROM forge.merge_request_discussions WHERE merge_request_id = <id>; SELECT discussion_id, count(*) FROM forge.merge_request_notes WHERE merge_request_id = <id> GROUP BY discussion_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5.

## 対処 (fix)

Continue in an existing discussion (or resolve and summarize), or split the work into a new merge request. The caps are constants (forge_db::review::MAX_DISCUSSIONS / MAX_NOTES / MAX_NOTES_PER_DISCUSSION); raising them is a code change that must raise the list's caps together.
